cohort: This study included 108 primigravida women at 24-28 weeks gestation, divided into 54 with pregnancy-induced hypertension and 54 normotensive controls.
finding: The study found that platelet indices (MPV and PDW) and serum uric acid were significantly associated with preeclampsia and its severity.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with preeclampsia.
